currentUserGoal: Add the Last Stand mechanic to the redesign branch as a real meta-unlocked one-use revive per run.
summary: Added Last Stand as a permanent upgrade id in the run spine, costing 32 permanent GT.
Last Stand now triggers automatically when active HP would hit zero, restores 35% of max HP, marks the revive as spent, and keeps the run active.
A second HP-zero event after Last Stand is spent enters real dormancy and awards permanent GT normally.
The per-run Last Stand spent flag resets through createNextRunFromDormancy while the permanent unlock persists.
Added scene VFX/copy/debug state for the revive: field pulse, HP bar flash, Sensi bark, feed entry, wound-pressure breathing reset, and prompt text after the revive is spent.
Expanded the meta screen from four visible nodes to five, with Last Stand as a centered bottom node.
Extended the DOM agent/readable layer with the Last Stand memory button label and state lines for owned/armed/spent/triggered-at.
verification: npm run check: passed lint, tests, and build.

Browser smoke on http://127.0.0.1:5173/?redesign&resetMemory&skipIntro&fastDormancy: earned 48 RT, reached dormancy with 58 GT, bought redesign-memory-lastStand, started the next run, confirmed lastStandOwned and lastStandAvailable.
Continuous browser smoke confirmed the armed run stayed active after first HP-zero with HP 35, lastStandUsed true, lastStandTriggeredAt > 0, metaScreenVisible false, and lastScourgeEvent last-stand.
Same smoke confirmed second HP-zero entered dormancy with runEnded true, summaryVisible true, metaScreenVisible true, and no warn/error console logs.
